latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — AI-powered text-to-video creation for scripts and prompts.

- Generate 1080p MP4 videos from TXT, DOCX, PDF, or SRT files up to 500MB.
- Supports natural instructions: e.g. "turn this script into a 30-second video with visuals and background music."
- Handles session management, file upload, editing, preview, credits check, and export through a cloud API.
- Automatically manages tokens and sessions to streamline first-time setup.
- Exposes credits and status queries, and summarizes timeline/video composition in plain language.
- Error handling for uploads, token issues, missing headers, and rate limits.
